# Homebrew tap for Orin

```bash
brew install HenrySchwerdt/orin/orin
orin doctor
```

Upgrade with `brew upgrade orin`, remove with `brew uninstall orin` (and `brew untap HenrySchwerdt/orin`).

Supported: macOS on Apple silicon (arm64). Intel macOS and Linux use the install script or a release tarball
until their Homebrew smoke tests exist; see [docs/install.md](https://github.com/HenrySchwerdt/orin/blob/main/docs/install.md).
Orin releases are pre-releases (experimental).

`Formula/orin.rb` is generated by `tools/homebrew_formula.sh` in
[HenrySchwerdt/orin](https://github.com/HenrySchwerdt/orin) from the published release and its `SHA256SUMS`; each
release opens a pull request here with the new version. Edit the generator there, not the formula here. The template
of this repository lives in `dist/homebrew/tap/` of the compiler repository (ADR-0047 section 6).
